title: Spotify plans to raise its Premium subscription by $1 to $12.99/month for subscribers in the US, Estonia, and Latvia, in its first US hike since July 2024 (Molly Schuetz/Bloomberg)
summary: Molly Schuetz / Bloomberg: Spotify plans to raise its Premium subscription by $1 to $12.99/month for subscribers in the US, Estonia, and Latvia, in its first US hike since July 2024 — Spotify Technology SA is raising the price of its premium subscription service by 8% in an effort to achieve sustained profitability.
